text:
You need clearer attribution for a SaaS B2B measurement landscape where long sales cycles and complex buying journeys make it hard to connect customer value back to marketing.

I’m Mina Castellan, and with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I can help map the competitive landscape and turn research into clear findings.

In my Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I built a model joining ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; it led to 18% of ad budget reallocated and CAC down 12% the next quarter.

In my GA4 migration and tracking plan, I built a tracking plan and GTM setup moving the shop to GA4; 46 events were mapped with no gap in year-on-year reporting.

I’d be glad to research the market, compare offerings, and summarize strengths, weaknesses, and white space.
